## Backdraft — G4 dragon

**Who he is:** Backdraft is the stocky violet teenage dragon among Garble’s acquaintances in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Recognize his lavender swept-back crest, pale curved horns, big muzzle, yellowish eyes and purple wings. He appears in armor during the *Gauntlet of Fire*. **Vex** is an earlier name for this same dragon, not a secret identity.

**Naming:** The television character was not named onscreen. Early fan art called him **Vex**; Gameloft also initially used *Vex* (as a non-playable character), then **Violet Dragon**. The licensed Enterplay *Friends Forever* collectible card #13 names him **Backdraft, Full of Hot Air**, with the flavor text “Ask Backdraft a question and you might be there for a while.” The card set is distinct from the IDW comic *Friends Forever*. Sources: [G4 dragon roster](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_non-pony_characters/Dragons); [Gameloft Violet Dragon](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Violet_Dragon); [Backdraft card](https://mlpccg.fandom.com/wiki/Backdraft%2C_Full_of_Hot_Air).

**Appearances:** Debuts in **Dragon Quest** (S2E21); returns in **Gauntlet of Fire** (S6E5), **Celestial Advice**, **Shadow Play – Part 1**, **School Daze – Part 2**, **Sweet and Smoky**, **Between Dark and Dawn**, **The Ending of the End – Part 2**, and **The Last Problem**. A dream version appears in IDW *Friends Forever* #14. **Speaking:** No individually verified dialogue or credited voice actor; the card’s flavor text is not a spoken line.
